title: A Fair Price for Water
summary: The water tower's condenser coil cracked and the Guild's replacement only holds pressure until the afternoon heat window closes. Exchange to tower, one cracked-but-serviceable coil, before the town drinks air. A small clock, a small panic.

objectives.label: Take the condenser coil from the Guild exchange
Get the coil to the water tower before the window closes

offer.text: Condenser coil's cracked. The replacement loses pressure the moment the sun hits that corner of the tower, which it does in one hundred and fifty very enthusiastic seconds.
The Guild's position is that hydration is a right. The Guild's *invoice* position is that rights ride with the fastest courier. That's you. Congratulations on your rights.

accept.text: Clock starts when the coil leaves my hands. Which is now. Which is immediately. Go. Why are you reading.
Clock's running. Tell the tower to whistle when it sees me.
Ketch here. Cut the flats at the board corner and mind the laundry line at the mast. Town wasn't built for couriers in a hurry. It wasn't built for couriers at all, honestly.

complete.text: Installed, pressurised, and holding. The town drinks tonight, and the record will show the Guild graciously permitted it.
The record should show a courier did it.
The record shows a *Guild-licensed* courier did it. Count the difference twice — and here's your water-guilt bonus. Spend it at the garage like everyone does.
Nice line through the flats, kid. Sloppy at the tower, but the tower forgives. Water always does. That's why there's never enough of it.
